nodes.label: Lock Technical Contract
nodes.rationale: Jobs use tryLock 10-60s and skip if busy (lose turn over blocking). API uses tryLock(1500) and returns temporalmente_ocupado for instant frontend retry. Frontend implements auto-retry with backoff. Design intent: never block UI, prefer graceful degradation over exclusive access.
